'''B-NK1''' was a battle droid used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It operated in the back room of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] until it was destroyed.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
B-NK1 appears as a boss in the Shroud storyline, appearing on Coruscant for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] players and on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] players.<ref name="TOR" />
